headline: Guard note for rich/color.py edits
what_breaks: rich/console.py — relies on ColorSystem and ColorType
rich/style.py — depends on color definitions from this file
rich/palette.py — uses ANSI_COLOR_NAMES for color mapping
why: This file defines essential color systems and types used throughout the Rich library. Changes here can impact color rendering in multiple dependent modules.
checklist: Review changes to ColorSystem and ColorType classes
Ensure ANSI_COLOR_NAMES remains consistent with terminal standards
Check for any direct usage in rich/console.py, rich/style.py, and rich/palette.py
